caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular pouch or bag with a predominantly blue background. The bag features two large symmetrical spiral motifs in the center, each accompanied by a flower-like design with circular patterns; both motifs are rendered in shades of gold, brown, and muted green. The top edge of the bag has a scalloped trim in green and yellow, accented with red and white. Hanging from the upper corners are decorative elements: on the left, several round beads or buttons in greenish-brown, and on the right, similar beads along with a multi-colored tassel featuring long blue and green threads. The bottom edge of the pouch displays a zigzag pattern in pink and gold with small vertical green accents. The drawing is set against a plain, light background.
title: Reticule
